sections.overview: Plecturocebus vieirai is a titi monkey endemic to Brazil.
sections.identification: Species-specific field marks are poorly documented; it belongs to the South American titi monkeys in family Pitheciidae.
sections.habitat: Its range includes forest between the Xingu and Iriri rivers and forest east of the Teles Pires, in the southern Amazon region.
sections.diet: The sources reviewed provide no species-specific diet description.
sections.behavior: Detailed behavior has not yet been documented well enough to summarize confidently for this species.
sections.reproduction: Species-specific reproductive information was not available in the sources reviewed.
sections.ecology: Forest loss in northern Mato Grosso is identified as a concern, although the full distribution and population response remain uncertain.
sections.conservation: Brazil’s 2025 assessment report records Least Concern, while noting that projected habitat loss could justify a threatened category in future reassessment.
